events.title: Windows Pocket PC released
events.summary: Microsoft launched Pocket PC 2000 in April 2000 — a Windows CE PDA platform with Pocket Word, Excel, and Internet Explorer.
events.about: Pocket PC devices from HP, Compaq, and Dell targeted mobile professionals with stylus input and ActiveSync desktop pairing. Developers wrote Compact Framework and native C++ apps for enterprise mobile workflows before the iPhone reset expectations. The line evolved into Windows Mobile and eventually Windows Phone.

narrative.whyChosen: Pocket PC was Microsoft's first cohesive PDA platform for enterprise mobile development.
narrative.whyImportant: It created a Windows-native mobile app ecosystem for business users in the early 2000s.
narrative.problemSolved: Mobile workers needed Office-compatible documents and email on pocket devices beyond the Palm Pilot.
